verdict.rationale: Jeeves claims smart invoice scanning to capture recipient details, automated invoice payment and approval flows, and invoice audit trails. Its MCP server lets agents review bill-pay invoices and manage vendor payment details, which covers the routing-for-payment part of the story. Nothing shows invoices being matched to purchase orders or automatically coded to GL accounts, and the accounting sync is described only for exported payment transactions. Missing for 10: PO matching, automated GL/expense coding of invoices, detailed AP workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
